text:
Alex: Heads-up — I'm about to add a per-customer gate for the new VIP support flow. Thinking: allowlist + contract gating. Primary customers: AcmeCorp (acct_8023), BetaBank (acct_9012). Question: should the canonical check be account_id or contract_id for rollout rules? Planning a small canary (10% of VIP accounts) then widen. Any guardrails we should add?

Jamie: Prefer contract_id when legal/compliance differs by contract. account_id is fine for org-scoped feature access. For VIPs I'd do allowlist at account level + contract_id as an additional gate. Also add a hard kill switch and a throttled fallback.

Priya: Product note — contract gating required for BetaBank due to contract clause. We also want audit logs of who toggled the flag + reason. Can we capture the rollout label in the audit event?

Matt: Oncall/ops: add an automatic disable if error rate > 1% or latency p50 increases by > 2x over baseline for 5m. Also prefer doing canary during US morning (10:00–12:00 PT) so infra is staffed.

Alex: Got it. I'll implement both checks. Proposed quick config (proto):

```json
{
  "flag": "vip_support",
  "scope": "per_customer",
  "allowlist": ["acct_8023", "acct_9012"],
  "gating": {
    "primary_key": "contract_id",
    "canary": { "percent": 10, "audience": "vip_customers" },
    "guards": {
      "error_rate_threshold": 0.01,
      "latency_multiplier": 2.0
    }
  },
  "audit_meta": { "rollout_label": "vip-q1-2026", "changed_by": "Alex" }
}
```

Jamie: Looks good. Add a note that canary percent is on accounts not users (we don't want partial org exposure unless explicit). Also add a fallback route to the stable model if the feature is disabled.

Alex: Will do. I'll open a PR and tag @Jamie and @Priya for review. Targeting Thursday 09:30 PT for canary start. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: deploy started: vip-gatekeeper canary -> us-east-1 (initiated by Alex) — https://deploys.redwood.internal/dep/3218 :rocket:

Jamie: Thanks — watching the canary logs.

Matt: I'll add the alert rule and a quick runbook snippet to the incident playbook.

Alex: Thanks everyone, will post PR link here when ready.
